localdb.title: Instructions
localdb.content: All music info cached in the local indexedDb. All the operations can be done offline except for the track streaming. You can check and sync the data with the server(local playback data will be synced to the server first).

about.author: developed by {author} at spare time
about.introduction: This is a PWA music player developed with Vue3. Tech stack mainly includes Vue3, Vite, Typescript, Tailwindcss, PWA, workbox, IndexedDB, etc.
about.characteristics_1: Staged music based on folder, artist, album and genre.
about.characteristics_2: Atomic artist, track with multi-artists will record to every corresponding artist.
about.characteristics_3: Atomic genre, track with multi-genres will record to every corresponding genre.
about.characteristics_4: Decretized album, album with multi-artists will record to every corresponding artist.
about.characteristics_5: Cache music info in local IndexedDB, and can be synced with server.
about.characteristics_6: All operations can be done offline except track streaming based on ServiceWorker
about.characteristics_7: Multi-screen display based on MediaSession, so carplay likely supported.
about.characteristics_8: With PWA, can be installed as app.
